answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 35845 Country: India Title: My name is Subhan Ahmad. I want to know that whether this name is allowed in Shariah? If not, then what should I do now? Question: My name is Subhan Ahmad. I want to know that whether this name is allowed in Shariah? If not, then what should I do now? Answer ID: 35845 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 102/56/L=1433) You can keep the name ‘Subhan Ahmad’. However it is not right to name Abdus Subhan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
